author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Did you know Tolkien's Noldor were originally Gnomes? And that Tolkien was hesitant to use the term elves all because of William Shakespeare?  Today, we dive into this fascinating story behind the scenes of Tolkien's world!

Hit subscribe and the bell for great Tolkien content every week!
